title: Server room is too hot
symptom: The server room feels very warm and the air conditioning unit is not blowing cold air
user_description: I went into the server room with you earlier and it was like an oven in there. The air conditioner on the wall was quiet. Is that normal?

options.text: Prop the server room door open and put a desk fan inside
options.why: An open server room door lets anyone walk in, and a desk fan is not a fix. The cooling needs to be repaired properly.

options.text: Switch some servers off so the room cools down
options.why: Turning servers off yourself can corrupt data and stop services people need. That decision belongs to the server team.

options.text: Check the room temperature display and the air conditioning unit, then escalate to the server team straight away so they can protect the servers and get the cooling fixed
options.why: Servers can overheat and shut down or get damaged. The server team can watch temperatures, plan a safe shutdown if needed, and get facilities to repair the cooling.

options.text: Leave it until tomorrow, the servers have their own fans
options.why: Server fans only move the room's air. If the room is hot, the servers keep getting hotter and may crash or be damaged.

hints: What happens to servers when they get too hot?
real_world_tip: Many server rooms have a temperature display or sensor that sends alerts. Write down the reading and whether the cooling unit shows any error.

escalation.team_why: The server team watches server temperatures, can shut servers down safely if needed, and contacts facilities to repair the cooling.

details.text: The temperature shown in the room, if there is a display
details.why: Tells them how serious it is right now.

details.text: Whether the air conditioning unit is running or shows an error
details.why: Points to the cause, so facilities can be called quickly.
Helps them work out how long the servers have been running hot.

details.text: Any alarms or warning lights on the servers
details.why: Shows whether servers are already overheating.

details.text: The server room door code, so they can get in faster
details.why: Never send door codes in a ticket or message. The server team already has its own access.
